t: ff.132 An ode to video games
st: Why do gamers get an extra life?

sec.p: As a gamer and (ex) YouTuber with 50,000 subscribers, I care about video games.

sec.t: ff.132.2 The benefits of video games
sec.p: And anyway, is time spent “playing on the PlayStation” really wasted?

sec.t: ff.132.3 Measuring and modelling the world
sec.p: To “illude” (in-ludere, a word tied to the Latin ludus, play), a video game has to simulate, to model the world coherently (🎼 ff.98 Games and simulations).
To close the circle on video-game realism, some people wonder whether Skyrim's hydrogeology is accurate, hunting for the source of its rivers.
